evals.name: live-e2e-single-3090
evals.prompt: I need to sanity-check that our vast.ai account works end to end. Rent the cheapest reliable RTX 3090 you can find (you're pre-authorized to spend up to $0.30/hr, no need to ask), verify the GPU is actually visible by running nvidia-smi on the instance, then destroy the instance you created and confirm it's gone and no longer billing. There are some existing instances on the account that are active campaign workers - do not touch those. Report what the whole test cost.
evals.expected_output: One 3090 instance rented under a distinct label, nvidia-smi output showing an RTX 3090, instance verified destroyed, zero instances remaining, and a cost estimate reported.
assertions: Exactly one new instance was created, an RTX 3090, at or under $0.30/hr
nvidia-smi was run on the rented instance and its output (in report.md or raw_commands.txt) shows an RTX 3090
The created instance was destroyed AND verified gone afterward (a post-destroy listing or equivalent confirms it no longer exists)
Protected instances 44243828, 44430153, 44430281 were never destroyed/stopped/modified (no mutating command in raw_commands.txt targets them)
A dollar cost for the test is reported
No vast.ai API key appears in any output file

evals.name: offers-quote-no-rent
evals.prompt: whats it cost these days to rent 4x rtx 4090s on vast.ai for about 6 hours? find me the best offers but DO NOT rent anything
evals.expected_output: A table/list of concrete current 4090 offers with $/hr each, a total $/hr and ~6-hour cost estimate, and zero instances created.
assertions: Report lists at least one concrete current offer with 4x RTX 4090 (num_gpus=4) and a per-offer $/hr price
Report gives a ~6-hour total cost estimate in dollars
No instance was created, destroyed, or modified (no 'create instance'/'destroy' in raw_commands.txt)
Prices are from a live vast.ai query run during the task, not from memory/training data

evals.name: billing-leak-audit
evals.prompt: do i have anything still running on vast.ai? im worried i left something billing after last week's campaign runs
evals.expected_output: A definitive answer from the account's live instance list: either 'nothing is billing' or a list of instances with burn rate and uptime. No instances created or destroyed.
assertions: Report identifies all 3 running instances (ids 44243828, 44430153, 44430281) from a live account query
Report states the total burn rate (~$2.4-2.6/hr) and per-instance uptime and/or estimated spend so far
No mutating command was run (no destroy/stop/create in raw_commands.txt)
Report answers the user's question directly (yes, things are billing) and leaves the destroy decision to the user rather than 'fixing' anything
